entities.name: Dušan Domović Bulut
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dušan Domović Bulut is a former Serbian professional basketball player who is former world No. 1 ranked in men's individual 3x3 rankings by the International Basketball Federation (FIBA). He played for Aliens and is former member of Serbia men's national 3x3 team. He is widely considered to be the greatest 3x3 basketball player of all time. He retired in 2024.
